Dialogue.Page: Delica: cough cough Is it recording?
Brevipes: Yes, my dear sister. Do not strain yourself!
Delica: cough I appear to have contracted a disease unlike anything I have encountered before. I am now attempting to record its symptoms in the case of my death...
Delica: First comes a near constant nausea, then a periodical cough. I've begun feeling temperatures drastically higher than a normal fever and cough cough... Shortness of breath.

Delica: I was the first to show symptoms but, I'm told Ponderosa has reported feeling nauseous... I have a theory that this is being caused by the asteroid but I cannot be certain. If I'm right, may we be spared the worst.
